full_page.content:
Page 92
Nov. 29th Ray Yast - 40 - cancer of stomach - operation abandoned as hopeless - Enrolled To-day as hopeless ....
Edmund John Murer - 39 - T.B. of Spine - Operation tomorrow at 9 o'cl. planned ... is inrolled To-day for this intention.
Joseph Bornette - 41 - Ch. Scientist - Finantial - Lady friend & B. V.M. - dying 15 yrs. ago in dream.
Mrs.Martha Insko - 80 - failing sight - asks prayers also for oldest sister 100 nex May ....
Mrs. Josephine Kinney - See Jan. 3rd
Mrs. Susan Cousino - 53 - of Monroe - tuomer - operation feared - had 3 operations within a year.
Page 93
1938, December
Dec. 1 James Murray - 51 - throat-cancer - Drs give very little hope of recov- ery ... came in plane from California - Enrolled To-night in Ser. Mass Assoc'n.
2 Joseph Wolschan - 54 - fearful arthritis for near five yrs. His son Joseph 26 has T.B. of the bone in his arm ....
John Murphy - 12 - peculiar spells - had 19 a month .... Hazel Park Mrs. Olive E. Spicer - 72 - Toledo, 0. - neuritis, widow and quite helpless on
3rd Mary Jane Dorey - 44 - stomach obstruction - operation just a month ago .... here To-night not improved. Was enrolled. ... 17th Here To-night - feeling much improved ... Deo Gr .!
Mrs. Alice Freiberger - 30 - fearful Asthma
6 Helen Frances Walker - beautiful child - 10 months - brain tuomer feared ... taking her to Ann Arbor To-day
Mary J. Rause - 18 - mentel trouble - very serious .... in St. Josephs
Page 94 Dec. 6 Baby Kathleen Dillon - ten weeks - defective scull
